title: The Episode About the Guruship of Gulab Rai

blocks.text: The new episode begins with Gulab Rai establishing a guru-like seat at Damdama and attracting people who believe he can alter destiny. A childless woman arrives in deep hope, and she prayed to be blessed with two sons after hearing that this self-styled holy man grants heirs and prosperity.

The scene is sustained by public performance. Supported by followers, Gulab Rai receives her petition while the congregation watches to see whether his claimed authority extends to changing fate itself.

When he finally says she is not destined for children, the woman refuses to accept the verdict as final. Her challenge pushes the page toward its sharp comic test of whether borrowed guruship can withstand direct scrutiny.
